name: 阿宝 Aobao — the HSK AI panda
source: HSK AI app, AI Voice screen (videos/hsk-ai-explained/assets/ai-voice-conversation.png), crop x=370 y=610 w=440 h=520; owner decision 2026-11-09
identity: Aobao keeps EXACTLY the reference look: flat 2D vector mascot with thick black outlines and no fur texture; a round white head; two round black ears; two large black oval eye patches with closed, smiling eyes drawn as white arcs; a small round black nose; a small red smiling mouth; a red neckerchief tied with its knot on the panda's left side (viewer's right); a white pear-shaped body with short black arm outlines and small round white paws.
rules: Whenever an image needs a character, it is Aobao from this file; never invent another mascot or another panda design.
Pass content/characters/aobao-panda.png as the first reference image and add the identity text to the prompt.

Keep face, proportions, outline weight, colours and the red neckerchief unchanged; only pose, gesture, props and weather layers (sunglasses, knitted hat, coat over the neckerchief) may change when the script needs them.
Never render Aobao realistic, furry, 3D-sculpted or with open eyes.
